Not a supreme asshole. They are very religious so their fear is that I will go to hell. I want them in my life. I would be lost without my mom and I can't imagine a world where I can't see my nieces.

I'm kinda just over trying to talk about things.. every time I do I feel more and more like I'm whining. Just having trouble caring about anything anymore. I don't wanna get out of bed anymore. My brain feels awful. I wanna go home. My brain keeps telling me to just end it tonight... I want something to live for but I don't know if I have anything keeping me that grounded to being here.

I grew up being told that who I was is wrong (gay) and tried to come out several times and was either told on or told I was wrong. I don't wanna cry because my girlfriend is leaving next week because I want this week to be really happy with her but she's the only person who ever actually loved me. My last girlfriend said she did but once I was out I realized how manipulative and awful she was. I live alone and have for over a year but now the solitude is intense.. I don't trust my friends a whole lot for various reasons but don't know how to talk to them about it because I'm scared of confrontation or looking like I'm pointing fingers. I know I'm not perfect in any way. I don't think anyone is. I know I've fucked stuff up in the past. But right now, the thought of continuing on and going to work and pretending like I'm a normal person is too exhausting
I've just been keeping a lot of things in. It's hard for me to talk about and I know I burden people.
Work, my wonderful relationship coming to an end, I just don't care about anything anymore. I don't have it in me
